newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Hoechst plans 1997 New York listing.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Hoechst plans 1997 New York listing.

text.p: German chemicals giant Hoechst said Wednesday it planned to list its shares on the New York Stock Exchange in 1997 but said the move was not linked with plans to raise capital.
"We are not doing this in order to raise new capital," Hoechst chief financial officer Klaus-Juergen Schmieder said in a statement.
"Instead we want to continue to increase the attractiveness of our shares by making them available in this important capital market."
